summary: Colville Reservation lookout site: 1926 log cabin below the summit; tower abandoned 1952; cabin reportedly survived a 2021 fire.

facts.design: 1926 log cabin just below the summit; the 1938 30-foot steel tower with 7x7 cab is gone
facts.status_note: The tower and cab are gone. The 1926 log cabin below the summit was reported standing in 2019; whether it counts as a lookout is debated.

access.note: On the Colville Indian Reservation. The sources do not say which Colville Tribes permit applies; ask the Tribes first.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The tower and cab are gone, per firelookout.com. The 1926 log cabin is reported standing in 2014 (firelookout.com) and in 2019 (TrailChick). The brief's 'standing' entries appear to refer to the cabin, which is disputed as a lookout.
Firelookout.com and Willhite give 5,709 ft (1740 m) for the site; TrailChick gives a 5,520 ft summit figure. The record keeps 5,709 ft.

notes_for_editor: Tower gone and abandoned 1952 is well supported (firelookout.com, TrailChick, Willhite all quote the Kresek inventory). The 2021 fire details (lightning-started July 12, cabin reportedly survived) rest only on TrailChick, a hiking guide. Search snippets gave a July 12 or 13 start and a 45,461-acre figure on a Facebook post, which I did not read, so check an official fire source before publishing the fire paragraph. Brief's 'permission' access is not verified: the Tribes sell reservation permits and passes, but no source I read says which applies to Lynx, and the Colville Tribes permit page was not checked closely. Brief's lat/lon 48.37617, -118.42617 is about 250 m from TrailChick's 48.374479, -118.427135; not changed. The brief's conflict note calls firelookout.com 'standing', but the page I read ends 'Gone.' and notes the cabin was there in 2014. Budget: 2 WebSearch calls and 6 page reads; one read (tribaltribune.com) was rate-limited and not used.
